messages.text: Are these available to buy in Australia
Read the bsb b30 page
Searched the catalog · Harlo B30

Yes, the Harlo B30 can be bought and shipped to Australia. It's $899 USD, it's a pre-order, and it ships November 30, 2026. Shipping to your address is worked out at checkout.

On power, the supply is built in and rated 100 to 240 V, so it works on Australian 230 V mains. The listing only names US, UK and EU plugs, so I'll need to confirm which cord an Australian order comes with.

Were you looking at just the B30, or another model too?
